baseline: pnl_net_open (honest grade, 18:00-open fill, own-pair resolution, base costs); sensitivity pnl_net_open_hicost

random_filter_null.applies_to: H12 (the only rule that skips nights)

conventions.HH:00 close: the HH:00 ET print = close of the hourly bar labelled HH-1 (20:00 -> k=1, 22:00 -> k=3, 00:00 -> k=5 on a normal night)
conventions.H4 checkpoint: close of bar k = tokyo_open_bar (1 in EST, 2 in EDT) as registered
conventions.20:00 open: Open of the hour-20 bar (k=2 on a normal night)
conventions.verdict: computed on the registered population (A nights of the touched kind); the all-A series verdict is reported alongside
conventions.all_night_effect: rule on A nights only, spread over every OOS night of the window (ungraded = 0)

H4.rule: continuation checkpoint at the Tokyo cash open: exit at the close of bar k=tokyo_open_bar if adverse by > 0.25 x stop_dist
H4.decision_time: close of bar k=tokyo_open_bar (20:00 ET print in EST, 21:00 ET print in EDT)

H4_placebo_MR.rule: the H4 checkpoint applied to MEAN REVERSION (named placebo; expected to hurt)

TS20c.rule: time-stop: flat at the 20:00 ET print (close of the 19:00 bar) if unresolved, CONTINUATION only

TS20m.rule: time-stop at the 20:00 print on MEAN REVERSION (placebo of TS20c; forensics expects harm)

TS20c_b.rule: sensitivity to the convention: flat at the close of the bar LABELLED 20:00 (the 21:00 ET print, k=2), CONTINUATION (exploratory)

TS20m_b.rule: sensitivity to the convention: flat at the close of the bar labelled 20:00, MEAN REVERSION (exploratory)

TS22c.rule: time-stop at the 22:00 print (close of the 21:00 bar), CONTINUATION (exploratory)

TS22m.rule: time-stop at the 22:00 print, MEAN REVERSION (exploratory)

TS00c.rule: time-stop at the 00:00 print (close of the 23:00 bar), CONTINUATION (exploratory)

TS00m.rule: time-stop at the 00:00 print, MEAN REVERSION (exploratory)

H12.rule: two-stage MEAN REVERSION execution: fill at the 20:00 open only if the 18:00-20:00 move against the call is <= 0.25 x rng_q50_pts; pre-touched target/stop or unfillable at 20:00 = no fill
H12.decision_time: 20:00 ET open (Open of the hour-20 bar; uses bars k<=1 and the 20:00 print)

H12_placebo_flip.rule: H12 sign-flipped: cancel when the 18:00-20:00 move is WITH the call by more than 0.25 x rng_q50_pts

H12_uncond_e20.rule: reference: every MEAN REVERSION call filled at the 20:00 open (no cancel; pre-touched = no fill)

SCR00.rule: scratch handling (exploratory): a position open at the 00:00 print with adverse P&L is closed there
SCR00.parameters: adverse at the 00:00 print (exploratory, no parameter)

BE22.rule: MFE partial (exploratory): at the 22:00 print, if open and MFE >= 0.5 x target_dist, stop moves to the entry
